tools.name: search_entries
tools.description: Full-text search across hardware, controllers, protocols, standards, alarm codes, terms and manufacturers. Returns ids to pass to get_entry.

tools.name: get_entry
tools.description: Return the full structured record for one id: typed spec values, sources and verification status.

tools.name: find_hardware
tools.description: Find hardware matching numeric limits, manufacturer, controller and supported protocols, e.g. cobots with payload >= 10 kg that speak PROFINET.

tools.name: list_facets
tools.description: Valid values, with counts, for find_hardware filters: categories, manufacturers, controllers and protocols.

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Align 2 to 5 entries of the same type into one table of numeric spec values with units, plus each entry's verification status and sources. Requires an API key.

tools.name: check_limits
tools.description: Check planned payload, reach, TCP speed, repeatability, ambient temperature or IP rating against a robot's published limits. Returns pass/fail/unknown per check with the limit and its sources. Call this before generating code that moves real hardware. Requires an API key.

tools.name: get_related
tools.description: List entries connected to an id, in both directions: a robot's manufacturer, controllers and protocols, a controller's robots and alarm codes, or a base model's variants.

tools.name: lookup_alarm
tools.description: Find what a controller alarm or error code means and what to check. Accepts a full code (SRVO-062) or a prefix, optionally limited to one controller id.

tools.name: calculate_metric
tools.description: Evaluate a formula entry, such as OEE, with your inputs. Get the variable symbols from get_entry first.

tools.name: get_schema
tools.description: Return the JSON Schema every entry of a type conforms to. Use it to validate generated configs or to build a submission.
